name: real_v2_b1_learning_curve
user_approval: 2026-11-08: B1 numbers chosen by the user after B0 (H2 = both normal populations <= 5.5 false events/h and motor, sensor new-confirmation detection >= 80% each; S+R with equal total domain weight; event onset selected by inner CV). Line approved in the cross-domain draft decisions of the same day.
basis: B0 (artifacts/real_v2_b0_diagnostics/, commit 9044e26): strong Real-internal session difference (normal_full vs pre_fault AUC 0.972); Real-only GBT fault vs pre_fault AUC 0.975 [0.968, 0.982], motor 0.984, sensor 0.965; source GBT 0.757. B1 recommendation GO. Architect check: per-case paired AUC median 1.00 motor / 0.99 sensor; post_fault_normal and late normal-flight windows not systematically flagged, so the separation is not only time-in-flight.

questions.H1_source_value: With the same Real-label budget, does source + Real (S+R) beat Real-only (R)? Primary at the 25% fraction.
questions.H2_usability: With the full dev training folds, is there a Real event-level operating point with few false events on both Real normal populations and high new-confirmation detection for motor and sensor?

population.case_types_by_role_v1: test_fault -> fault case (family motor / sensor); test_normal, adapt_normal, calibrate_normal -> N1 normal_full flight; supplemental_normal_test -> supplemental segment (descriptive only)
population.windows: real_included_windows.csv rows of those cases, label qualified_y, tensors from windows/*.npz (as B0)
population.sealed: never opened (as B0, asserted, counts in receipt)

features_and_recipe: 130-dim stats() and HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=400, learning_rate=0.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, l2_regularization=1.0, random_state=0) exactly as B0; no search

arms.S: frozen artifacts/ens_internal_test_v1_20261105/gbt_full_train.pkl (sha256 df468524...6774); reference only, no selection, event onset 0.95 descriptive
arms.R: Real training-fold windows only; weights as B0 arm R (fault 1; normal total = number of normal windows, 50/50 between normal_origin normal_flight and normal_part_of_fault_case)
arms.S_plus_R: source train windows (cache/train.pt, 162069 windows, gbt_full_train weights) + Real training-fold windows with arm-R weights rescaled so that Real total weight = source total weight; one fit, no weight grid

learning_curve.subsets: within each outer training set, groups are ordered per stratum family key (motor / sensor / normal_full / normal_segment) by sha256('real_v2_b1|' + rep + '|' + group) and the first ceil(fraction x n) groups are taken; nested across fractions within a repeat
learning_curve.repeats: rep 0..4 for fractions < 1.0; a single fit at 1.0

window_metrics.per_arm_fraction_repeat: pooled outer-OOF: AP (fault vs all normal), AUC (fault vs pre_fault), normal FPR per normal population at the threshold giving pooled fault recall 0.8 (descriptive)
window_metrics.H1: delta AP = AP(S+R) - AP(R), mean over the 5 repeats at fraction 0.25; association-group cluster bootstrap over dev groups (2000, rng 20261108), resampling groups and recomputing the repeat-mean delta. H1 holds if the CI lower bound > 0. Same statistic at 0.10, 0.50 and 1.00 reported descriptively

event_level.fractions: 1.00 only (arms R and S+R); S at onset 0.95 descriptive
event_level.frame_scoring: continuous replay of every non-sealed, non-quarantine dev case from cases/*.npz with case_windows (window end every valid frame), stats() and the relevant model; features may be cached once per case
event_level.policy: OnlineDetectionPolicy inference_every 1, clear 0.40, k_on 3, k_off 3, min_event 0.5 s, merge 0.5 s; aggregate_scores; onset grid 0.45, 0.50, ..., 0.95

definitions.false_event: finalized event lying entirely in normal_time (as ens_event_threshold.py)
definitions.N1_rate: false events in N1 normal_full flights / their normal_time hours
definitions.N2_rate: false events in fault cases that end before the reference onset / normal_time hours before onset in fault cases
definitions.post_fault_false_events: false events in fault cases after the reference onset (descriptive)
definitions.detected: fault case with a confirmation whose candidate_start >= reference onset; denominator = fault cases with scored frames after onset; per family motor / sensor
definitions.latency: first such confirmation time - onset; median and P90 per family (descriptive)

event_level.inner_selection: for each outer fold k and arm: fit one model per inner fold j != k on the other three training folds (same arm recipe, fraction 1.0), score fold j cases -> inner OOF frames over the 4 training folds. Feasible onset: inner-OOF detection >= 0.80 for motor and for sensor. Choose the feasible onset with the lowest pooled (N1 + N2 false events) / (N1 + N2 normal hours); ties -> more detected, then lower onset. If none is feasible: take the onset maximising min(motor, sensor detection), flag 'no_feasible_onset' for that fold; no other fallback
event_level.outer_evaluation: outer fold k cases are scored by the arm's fold-k model (fit on all four training folds) at the onset chosen for fold k; results pooled over the 5 folds
event_level.H2: for an arm, H2 holds if pooled outer N1_rate <= 5.5 and N2_rate <= 5.5 false events/h and detection >= 0.80 for motor and >= 0.80 for sensor (point values). H2 is evaluated for S+R and R separately; the line 'H2 holds' if at least one arm passes. Association-group bootstrap CIs (2000, rng 20261108) reported for the four quantities, not used for the verdict

descriptive: learning-curve table and plot data: arm x fraction x repeat window metrics
per outer fold: chosen onset, feasibility, inner-OOF rates
N1, N2 separately by flight directory; supplemental segments and post-fault false events
per-case paired fault vs pre_fault AUC distribution for R and S+R at 1.0 (session check)
S at onset 0.95 on the same dev cases (N1, N2, detection)
fit receipts: n_iter_, fit time, training window counts per fit

consequences.H1_and_H2: propose B2 (T1 MSTCA source retraining + Real fine-tuning) to the user
consequences.H2_only: Real-supervised detection is usable but source pretraining adds no measurable value at this budget; report, user decides whether T1 is still worth GPU
consequences.H2_fails: report which condition fails; no B2; back to data / label level with the user

not_allowed: opening sealed-partition files or computing on sealed rows
changing fractions, repeats, weights, grid, policy, thresholds, selection rule or criteria after any result
internal test; M0/MSTCA; GPU; T1 training; starting B2
relabelling or excluding cases after seeing results
outputs: artifacts/real_v2_b1_learning_curve/ (receipt.json, results.json, window_metrics.csv, onset_selection.csv, events_per_case.csv, run.log, execution_notes.md); script scripts/research/real_v2_b1_learning_curve.py; report docs/research/2026-11-08/跨域B1学习曲线结果_v1.md. Models and frame scores stay local, sha256 in the receipt.
